title: UserAppMenuCustomization - Data API
description: Represents an individual user’s settings for items in the app menu or App Launcher. This object is available in API version 35.0 and later.

ApplicationId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
ApplicationId.description: The 15-character ID for the application associated with the menu item. This is a relationship field.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the user for these specific settings. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

SortOrder.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
SortOrder.description: The index value that controls where this item appears in the menu. For example, a menu item with a sort order value of 5 will appear between items with sort order values of 3 and 9.

usage: See the AppMenuItem object for the organization-wide default settings This object contains the fields representing any changes the user made to the menu.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **UserAppMenuCustomizationOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **UserAppMenuCustomizationShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
